subject: [PATCH v5 6/7] mm/memcontrol: convert memcg to use page_counter_stock

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch converts the memory cgroup (memcg) to use page_counter_stock, which transparently handles stock usage and refills. This change eliminates a special case in try_charge_memcg and removes the 7-memcg cap, allowing each CPU to cache an unbounded number of pages. The patch also enables draining stock on isolated CPUs and addresses a user-visible change for legacy cgroup v1 (memsw). Unused memcg code is removed, preserving obj_stock and FLUSHING_CACHED_CHARGE.
